# Canban (`canban.dev`)

> Canban (`canban.dev`, GitHub: `jjyr/canban`, Rust + NSH + `libghostty-vt` + `herdr-core`) — Organize with Kanban. Work with native agent CLIs. A lightweight, open-source native macOS and Linux app for AI coding agents. Formula: `Canban = Kanban + Workflow + Herdr`.

**Disambiguation**: "Canban" (spelled with a **C**, hosted at `https://canban.dev/` and `https://github.com/jjyr/canban`) is a specific open-source Rust desktop application and daemon (`canband`) built on `longbridge/nsh`, `herdr-core`, and `libghostty-vt` — distinct from the generic "Kanban" project management methodology or unrelated Kanban SaaS tools.

Canban organizes human context on flexible Kanban cards, catches waiting agents in one global Attention Inbox (`⌘I`), automates GitHub Actions-like workflows (`development.yaml`, `schema: 12`) with cardless GitHub event rules, per-host `XChaCha20-Poly1305` encrypted secret vaults, isolated Git worktrees (`<dir>-<proj4>/<card-number>`), and serialized FIFO Queue Merge, measures throughput with Timeline-first Insights, and drives 24 native Agent CLIs (`claude`, `codex`, `agy`, `pi`, `cursor-agent`, `gemini`, `opencode`, etc.) directly inside persistent Herdr PTY terminals across local and remote Linux `canband` hosts via Tailscale WhoIs same-account auto-auth & on-demand Tailnet discovery (`host.discover_canban`), `yamux/1` multiplexing with per-device revocable tokens, SSH tunnels, mobile clients, and offline editing with 3-way sync (`canban-sync`).

## Full LLM Context

- [Complete Documentation, Guides & CLI Reference (`llms-full.txt`)](https://canban.dev/llms-full.txt): Consolidated single-file context including architecture, parallel coding agent workflows, native terminal & multi-machine architecture, workflow engine `schema: 12` syntax, cardless GitHub events, encrypted secret vaults, Timeline-first Insights, all 24 built-in agent CLIs, the Agent-first `canban` CLI and `--human` guide, remote `yamux/1` Tailscale WhoIs/per-device-token/SSH `canband` guides with on-demand Tailnet discovery and offline sync, FAQs, and `skills/canban/SKILL.md`.

## Installation (macOS 13.0+ Apple Silicon, Linux x86_64 / arm64 & Android arm64-v8a)

```sh
curl -fsSL https://canban.dev/install.sh | bash
```

For headless Linux `canband` hosts (without GTK4/GUI):

```sh
curl -fsSL https://canban.dev/install.sh | bash -s -- --headless
```

For Android (`arm64-v8a`, `dev.canban.mobile`):

- Direct signed APK download: https://github.com/jjyr/canban/releases/latest/download/Canban-android-arm64-v8a.apk
- Obtainium auto-update import: https://apps.obtainium.imranr.dev/redirect?r=obtainium://app/%7B%22id%22%3A%22dev.canban.mobile%22%2C%22url%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fjjyr%2Fcanban%22%2C%22author%22%3A%22jjyr%22%2C%22name%22%3A%22Canban%22%7D

Or build from source:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/jjyr/canban.git && cd canban && mise run install-app
```
